title: alchemilla vulgaris subvar. latiloba
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. latiloba, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a perennial flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to treat menstrual disorders and promote wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of lady's mantle include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and astringent properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health issues. Lady's mantle contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
